name: Typing card
what: A card - a dark note, a terminal window or paper - swings in tilted; its text types in letter by letter behind a cursor, the card floats and slowly straightens.

learned_from.what: the dark tilted note card typing a paragraph, the soft shadow
the terminal window, a line of code typing with a cursor
the window chrome, lines typing in

motion: in 20 f (power3.out, from 3x the tilt), 30 letters a second, the cursor blinks every 15 f, the card floats to 40 % of its tilt
